label: post-hoc, development data, not confirmatory
task: W15 post-hoc case study: new-item purchase rates and the value of an exploration slot

definitions.prior: items of the user's earlier baskets of the same split (history + target), i.e. baskets with a smaller basket_seq
definitions.user_weighted: mean over users of the per-user mean
definitions.history_length: distinct history baskets of the user in the split (nbr.pipeline.history_lengths)

history_min3.description: history baskets with >= 3 distinct items (2nd basket on)

rank_hits.definition: P(hit at rank j) = share of all target users whose list has an item at rank j that is in their target basket; share_present = share of users with an item at rank j; p_hit_given_present = hits / users with an item

slot10_explore1_vs_repeat10.description: explore rank 1 minus repeat rank 10 (the slot that changes under r = 9); hits per user

slots9_10_explore12_vs_repeat910.description: explore ranks 1 + 2 minus repeat ranks 9 + 10 (the slots that change under r = 8); hits per user

definition.lists: nbr.combine.combine(repeat, explore, r, 10): the first r slots from the repeat list (fewer when the user has fewer repeat candidates), then explore items, then leftover repeat items

metrics.new_recall: new-item Recall@10 (users with >= 1 new target item)
metrics.new_hit_share: share of users with >= 1 new-item hit in the top 10 (all users)
metrics.repeat_recall: repeat Recall@10 (users with >= 1 repeat target item)

definition.diff: mean(r = 9 or 8) - mean(r = 10) per user, paired bootstrap 95 % CI

history_min3.description: history baskets with >= 3 distinct items (2nd basket on)

slot_curves.definition: fit-split NDCG@10 of combine(repeat, E2, r), r in 0..10; r* = pipeline.select_r (argmax, ties -> larger r); R2 scored with the C* model fitted on the LR training users and evaluated on the validation users (pipeline.tune_integration), R1 on all fit users
